call_points.text: No numeric FY27 revenue guidance; CDMO expected to post positive growth with possible quarter-to-quarter lumpiness.
call_points.versus_prior: reiterated: still no numeric FY27 revenue guidance

call_points.text: Operating leverage is still to play out; management expects some in FY27 as capacity utilisation rises.
Net debt ₹2,285 Cr; debt/EBITDA 1.25x versus 2.3x last year; gross debt may rise slightly in FY27.
Unit 7 greenfield first production ready for commercial validation by March 2027; four more blocks in FY28.
Laurus Bio has 250,000 litres of fermentation capacity; another 400,000 litres comes by end-2026.
Solvent price increases hit Q4FY26; management sees no supply disruption through June but expects some cost pressure.
Effective tax rate guided at around 25-26% for FY27.
ARV revenue was ₹2,800 Cr in FY26 and expected to stay around that level, with its share falling.
No numeric FY27 revenue or margin guidance given; the deck is a FY26 review with capex timelines only.
New 532-acre Vizag site capex begins end-FY27, part of an 8-year, >$600 mn investment plan.
R&D spend was ₹282 Cr, 4.1% of FY26 revenue.
Operating cash flow rose 170% to ₹1,624 Cr on higher EBITDA and improved net working capital.

entities.name: KRKA Pharma Private Limited
entities.type: 49% joint venture with KRKA d.d., Novo mesto

operating_notes.text: CDMO small-molecule active projects rose to 125 in FY26 from 110 in FY25.
ARV revenue was ₹2,807 Cr in FY26, 41% of revenue, down from 62% in FY20.
Reactor volume crossed 8,200 kL in FY26; FDF capacity rose 20% in FY26.
KRKA Pharma Private Limited turnover for FY2025-26 was INR 10.47 million.
Board approved voluntary closure of step-down subsidiary Laurus Generics GmbH, Germany.
FY26 reactor volume exceeded 8,200 cubic metres for small molecule, API and intermediate manufacturing.
ARV revenue was ₹2,800 Cr in FY26, about two-thirds API and one-third formulations, and is expected to stay around that level.
Formulation capacity rose 20% in FY26 to 12 billion units; 92 DMFs filed cumulatively and 94 product filings in developed markets.
CDMO small molecule revenue was ₹835 Cr in Q1FY27, up 69%, with 55% from commercial supplies and 45% mostly Phase III; FY26 commercial share was 50%.
Laurus Bio Q1FY27 sales were about ₹35 Cr, up 21% YoY; Phase 1 fermentation capacity of over 400 kiloliters expected operational towards the end of this year.
Krka JV: ₹400 Cr invested so far, another ₹400 Cr needed; oncology facility ready early next year, solid oral facility in H2 CY2027.
Laurus subscribed 10.78 crore KRKA shares at ₹10 each for ₹107.8 Cr, holding 26.215 crore shares or 49% after the rights issue.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹1,811.57 Cr (+5.3% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹279.14 Cr (+19.5% YoY).
FY26 results presentation (30 Apr 2026): revenue ₹6,813 Cr (+23%), EBITDA ₹1,826 Cr (26.8% margin), net profit ₹889 Cr (+148%); CDMO up 36%, ARV share down to 41%.
Laurus Labs reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹6,813 Cr (+23% YoY) and net profit of ₹889 Cr (+148% YoY).
Laurus Labs approved an investment of up to €9.8 million in its joint venture KRKA Pharma Private Limited to fund a manufacturing facility capex.
Laurus Labs approved the voluntary closure of its step-down subsidiary Laurus Generics GmbH.
G. Venkateswar Reddy, Director, signed the audio recording link for Laurus Labs’ Q4 FY26 results conference call held on April 30, 2026.
Laurus Labs' Q4FY26 call (30 Apr 2026) raised two-year capex to about ₹3,000 Cr from ₹1,000 Cr a year and guided to maintain or improve the 26.8% FY26 EBITDA margin in FY27.
Laurus Labs announced its maiden inclusion in the Dow Jones Best-in-Class World Index with an S&P Global CSA score of 81.
Venkata Ravi Kumar Vantaram, Whole-time Director & CPO cum Promoter, declared no new encumbrances by Laurus Labs’ Promoter Group under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4) & (5) as of April 07, 2026.
Q1FY27 (Jul 2026): revenue rose 29% to ₹2,026 Cr and EBITDA margin expanded 7 pp QoQ to 31.8%; FY27 capex guidance raised to ₹2,000 Cr.
2026-10-14: Laurus invested ₹107.8 Cr in KRKA Pharma's rights issue, keeping its stake at 49%.

upcoming_events.description: Record date for 2nd Interim Dividend of ₹1.20 per share
Additional packaging line at Unit 2 full commercial production from June 2026
Laurus Bio fermentation Phase 1 capacity operational by end of 2026
Unit 7 greenfield first production ready for commercial validation by March 2027
KRKA JV formulation facility Phase 1 completion by mid-2027
